description: Test suite for authentication-related functionalities in the focalboard server, including login, user retrieval, registration, and password updates.

methods.name: TestLogin
methods.description: Tests the login functionality with various credential scenarios.

methods.name: TestGetUser
methods.description: Tests retrieving a user by ID with valid and invalid IDs.

methods.name: TestRegisterUser
methods.description: Tests user registration with existing and new usernames/emails.

methods.name: TestUpdateUserPassword
methods.description: Tests updating user password with valid and invalid usernames.

methods.name: TestChangePassword
methods.description: Tests changing password with correct and incorrect old passwords.
